modmenu.summaryTranslation.lava_boat_clu: Mends the lava boat clutch mechanic, methinks
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lava_boat:
Brings back the lava boat clutch mechanic that got mended in 1.21.5.

On first lava touch the boat gets a short warding time, so the player can land on its hitbox.

Now you can do lava grasps like Dream but in newer builds!
config.lava_boat_clutch.title: Lava Boat Clutch Fix Settings
config.lava_boat_clutch.enable_mod.toolt: Switches on or off the lava boat clutch mechanic.
config.lava_boat_clutch.immunity_ticks.t: The tally of ticks wherein the boat does not burn in the lava.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_mode:
Inborn: uses inborn speed
Handmade: uses settable speed.
Random: uses randumz velocity.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_y.to: Upward speed put on the boat's drop after boat burn in lava.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_x.to: Sideways speed along the X shaft put on the boat's drop after boat burn in lava.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_z.to: Sideways speed along the Z shaft put on the boat's drop after boat burn in lava.
